quotes.text: This paper proposes a novel approach, Digital Twin (DT)-driven reinforcement learning (RL) for dynamic path planning of automated guided vehicles (AGVs) systems.
quotes.section: Abstract (only part visible; not usable for coding)

quotes.text: The complex real-world path planning problem is represented as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and a DT-based Q learning algorithm that can solve the represented path planning problem is proposed.
